name: Sparse Solid Voxelization
definition: A method for solid voxelization using a sparse hierarchical structure (octree) where nodes representing uniform regions are not further refined, performed directly into the hierarchical structure.
summary: Sparse Solid Voxelization converts triangular meshes into solid hierarchical voxel data via a GPU-optimized sparse octree, avoiding dense grids by building the structure up-front and using level-0 sub-grids for efficiency.
